lines.text: We should handle our own affairs.
You guys did a great job out there.
If you need me for anything, just give me a shout.
Don't you have anything better to do than just stand there?
Suit yourself, I don't mind staying like this.

No need for introductions.
I'll wander around by myself.
This place is quite advanced. Impressive.

Peace and quiet.
What a dreamy place...
I'm A2, and I'll be joining you, although not for long.
Now I can wreak as much havoc as I like.
What's this? I suppose I'll accept it for now.
You don't have some ulterior motive, do you?
I don't know what exactly this is... but thank you anyway.
You're a better person than I thought.
I will return the favor, you'll see.
Don't tell me what to do.
We right back with you in a second.
They caught me with my guard down... retreat.
